name: CA Cultural Technology Group Limited
summary: CA Cultural Technology Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the establishment and operation of indoor theme parks in the People's Republic of China, Japan, and Hong Kong. It operates through three segments: Sales of Animation Derivative Products; Establishment and Operation of Indoor Theme Parks; and Multimedia Animation Entertainment. The company manufacture, sale, and trades in animation derivative products; sale of theme park machineries and admission tickets; and multimedia animation entertainment business.
